# ShareMatch

> The world's first Shariah-compliant tokenised asset marketplace. Performance-based digital assets across sport, culture, and global events. Built on Solana. Backed by a formal Fatwa.

ShareMatch is a regulated real-world-asset (RWA) exchange that fractionalises sport, culture, and event outcomes into Shariah-compliant tradeable shares. Minimum ticket: $5. Settlement: USDC on Solana.

## Products

- [Markets](https://sharematch.me/markets): Live tokenised markets (team performance, event outcomes, cultural indices)
- [How it works](https://sharematch.me/how-it-works): Minting, pricing, settlement, redemption
- [Shariah compliance](https://sharematch.me/shariah): Fatwa, scholar board, screening process
- [Invest](https://sharematch.me/invest): Token economics, value accrual, investor deck

## Key facts

- **Network**: Solana (low-fee, high-throughput settlement)
- **Minimum investment**: $5 per trade
- **Compliance**: Shariah-certified via formal Fatwa; independent Shariah-board screening
- **Regulation**: UAE licensed (see /compliance for jurisdictional details)
- **Founder**: Will (@sharematch.me, CEO & Co-founder)
